## Description {#details}

<p>This file implements a virtual register coloring pass.</p>


<p><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/namespaces/llvm/webassembly">WebAssembly</a> doesn't have a fixed number of registers, but it is still desirable to minimize the total number of registers used in each function.</p>


<p>This code is modeled after <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/lib/lib/codegen/stackslotcoloring-cpp">lib/CodeGen/StackSlotColoring.cpp</a>.</p>
